items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Yes. Sir Charles, yes. That was a fairly nice trip until it got kind of rough near the end

ctx.x: Did you take Sir Charles on that trip?

Yes. Sir Charles, yes. That was a fairly nice trip until it got kind of rough near the end because the bookings had been badly booked. Some of the dates were cut out and it wasn't as good, I don't think it was as good as the first one, you know.
As good a band but not as good ......

items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: And from there I had the pleasure of going to Europe with Buck Clayton and his fine group.

ctx.x: Who did you have in that group, can you remember?

I had a saxophone player by the name of Percy France, a genius player, very wonderful player. And I had a drummer by the name of Danny Farrar, spelled F-a-r-r-a-r. He later went with Jonah Jones for awhile, good drummer, played with good feeling. And that was very exciting experience. And from there I had the pleasure of going to Europe with Buck Clayton and his fine group.
That was a wonderful band Buck had,
